patch_bigquery_table_schema: run the script with --bq_result_table dataset.table to patch a BigQuery table schema
patch_results_table_function: call _patch_results_table with a dataset_id and table_id to update the BigQuery schema
load_scenario_result_schema: load the scenario_result_schema.json file to get the BigQuery table schema definition
create_bigquery_client: use big_query_utils.create_big_query to create a BigQuery client instance
review_patch_schema_cli: review the argparse CLI that accepts --bq_result_table to patch scenario results tables
